name.help: Display name for this Discord communication channel.

webhook_url.help: Discord channel webhook URL. Stored encrypted at rest.

title: Discord notification delivery
subtitle: Plugin-owned communication channel
description: This plugin owns the Discord. It stores the Discord webhook URL on the channel itself and dispatches notifications through the plugin runtime.
securityDescription: The webhook URL is stored encrypted at rest. Create a dedicated webhook for McHarbor so it can be rotated independently.
testDescription: The host test action posts a real message to the configured Discord channel. Use a private test channel first if the webhook targets an on-call room.
secretKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the stored value.

step1.body: Open the target Discord server and create a dedicated text channel for McHarbor alerts, or choose an existing operations channel.

step2.body: Open channel settings, go to Integrations, create a webhook, and copy the webhook URL.

step3.body: Paste the webhook URL into this channel configuration. McHarbor stores it encrypted at rest and redacts it from API responses.

step4.body: Save the channel and click Test connection. The plugin posts a real test message to Discord through the same path used for live workflow, alert, and backup events.

step5.body: If Test fails, verify the webhook was not deleted, the channel still exists, and server permissions allow webhook posts.
